title: 船舶拆解材料回收
subcategoryTitle: 量測、可靠度與數位驗證
summary: 以物料清單、秤重和去向記錄建立船舶回收的質量閉合，獨立追蹤有害與未知物質。 在船舶回收物料流與證據室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Close ship-recycling mass balances using inventories, weighing and destinations while tracking hazardous/unknown materials separately. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Ship-recycling material-flow/evidence studio. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 船體物料輸入輸出：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Hull-material inflows/outflows: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 船體物料輸入輸出 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Hull-material inflows/outflows and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「船舶拆解材料回收」的「船體物料輸入輸出」中，材料回收必須追蹤輸入、回收、損失和待處理庫存。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：以物料清單、秤重和去向記錄建立船舶回收的質量閉合，獨立追蹤有害與未知物質。
steps.instructionEn: Within Ship dismantling and material recovery, Hull-material inflows/outflows examines this mechanism: Material recovery must track input, recovered output, loss and pending inventory. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Close ship-recycling mass balances using inventories, weighing and destinations while tracking hazardous/unknown materials separately.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：輸入1000 kg，回收鋼850 kg、其他50 kg。關係式 unaccounted=Min−ΣMout；含單位換算算式 1000-850-50 = 100 kg。適用條件：純質量帳；不代表有害物質已妥善處理或設施合規。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Input 1000 kg, recovered steel 850 kg and other materials 50 kg. Relation unaccounted=Min−ΣMout; expression including unit conversion 1000-850-50 = 100 kg. Applicability: Mass balance only; not proof of hazardous-material handling or compliance.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：把未知損失歸為可回收會虛增循環率。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Counting unknown losses as recovered inflates circularity. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「船體物料輸入輸出」，分列可回收、有害和未知物質，保留批次與秤重證據。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Hull-material inflows/outflows, Separate recyclable, hazardous and unknown materials with batch/weighing evidence. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.

steps.objective: 辨識 秤重設備與批次基準 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Weighing equipment and batch references and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「船舶拆解材料回收」的「秤重設備與批次基準」中，兩點線性校正將原始讀值映射到參考量。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：以物料清單、秤重和去向記錄建立船舶回收的質量閉合，獨立追蹤有害與未知物質。
steps.instructionEn: Within Ship dismantling and material recovery, Weighing equipment and batch references examines this mechanism: Two-point calibration maps raw readings onto reference values. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Close ship-recycling mass balances using inventories, weighing and destinations while tracking hazardous/unknown materials separately.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：原始100→0、原始900→40；待測原始500；本練習以量測全尺度百分比 %FS 表示輸出或誤差，與真實感測器量程分開。關係式 y=(x−100)40/(900−100)；含單位換算算式 (500-100)*40/(900-100) = 20 %FS。適用條件：只在兩校正點間近似線性；不能證明全範圍或跨環境準確。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Raw 100→0, raw 900→40; test raw 500; output or error is expressed as percent of measurement full scale (%FS), separate from a real sensor range. Relation y=(x−100)40/(900−100); expression including unit conversion (500-100)*40/(900-100) = 20 %FS. Applicability: Linear interpolation only; not full-range or cross-environment accuracy.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：用參與擬合的兩點驗證自己會得到虛假的完美結果。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Validating only on fitted endpoints creates false perfect agreement. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「秤重設備與批次基準」，加一個中間檢核點且不參與擬合，觀察非線性殘差。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Weighing equipment and batch references, Hold out a midpoint reference to reveal nonlinear residuals. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.

Identify the single changed input and predict direction before calculating 22 %FS, versus baseline 20 %FS. Save inputs, units, both outputs and one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated; use only digital models or paper.

For Weighing equipment and batch references, Hold out a midpoint reference to reveal nonlinear residuals. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.
